title: Sunday Sandwiches
setting: A bright family kitchen on a cold winter day.

characters.name: Ali
characters.look: Ali, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt

characters.name: Rosa
characters.look: Rosa, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress

sentences.en: It is a slow Sunday in January.
sentences.zh: 这是一月里一个悠闲的星期天。
sentences.scene_prompt: A quiet kitchen in winter, snow outside the window; Ali, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt and Rosa, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress sit relaxed in pyjamas.

sentences.en: Making sandwiches is Rosa's favourite hobby.
sentences.zh: 做三明治是罗莎最喜欢的爱好。
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress happily spreads butter on bread at the kitchen counter.

sentences.en: Today she makes a large number of them.
sentences.zh: 今天她做了一大堆三明治。
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress stands proudly beside a tall pile of sandwiches.

sentences.en: Ali puts chips in his and enjoys it.
sentences.zh: 阿里往自己的三明治里放了薯片，吃得很开心。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt pushes crisps into his sandwich and takes a happy bite.

sentences.en: They stand by the window and talk about school.
sentences.zh: 他们站在窗边，聊着学校的事。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt and Rosa, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress stand by the window eating sandwiches and chatting.

sentences.en: They are full, so eating more is not possible.
sentences.zh: 他们吃饱了，再也吃不下了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt and Rosa, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress hold their full bellies, a few sandwiches still on the plate.

sentences.en: Then something funny happens: the cat takes one!
sentences.zh: 接着发生了一件好笑的事：猫叼走了一个！
sentences.scene_prompt: A gray cat jumps onto the table and runs off with a sandwich in its mouth.

sentences.en: Rosa laughs, "Our cat must love sandwiches too!"
sentences.zh: 罗莎笑着说：“我们的猫一定也爱吃三明治！”
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress laughs and points at the cat eating the sandwich while Ali, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt grins.
